sources.name: NIST DLMF
sources.accessConditions: Public site. Inspect the candidate-free search guide at https://dlmf.nist.gov/help/search. Sending a candidate query requires separate authorization.
sources.limitations: Covers its handbook on mathematical functions. Automatic relaxation may return partial or approximate matches. Inspect the equation and its stated hypotheses in context.

sources.name: mathlib4
sources.accessConditions: Search a locally imported environment at the specified revision. See https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/428aa8288d061ec3ae75c1b85ac178e2cb9def23/Mathlib/Tactic/Find.lean.
sources.limitations: Only imported formal declarations are visible. Record types, coercions, namespaces and translation into Lean. A missing formal match leaves other mathematical literature unexamined.
